content.text:
I'm ready to help you with command execution and file operations in your beni-capital project.

I can see from the git status that you have several modified and added files related to:
- Project setup forms and admin features
- Financial analysis components (categories table, weeks to recoupment charts/tables)
- Project details (biography, creative team, overview, timeline)
- UI components (sidebar, mobile menu)
- Configuration files (package.json, tailwind.css, types)

What would you like me to help you with today?
